_about: Heinrich Bullinger (1504-1575) in English, the works not on the heinrich-bullinger shelf (draft PR #14, which holds the Parker Society Decades, the standard translation): A Hundred Sermons upon the Apocalypse (tr. John Daus, 1573) (the Matrimonye and the 1551 Dialogue are pending: neither scan prints his name). Texts are from Internet Archive scans of the first printings. A gaps shelf, after the chesterton-gaps precedent, so as not to edit another thread's shelf. Added 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Reformed authors table). No uids minted.

bullinger-apocalypse-1573: A hundred sermons upon the Apocalypse of Jesu Christ, tr. John Daus (London: John Day, 1573)

_excluded.bullinger-fiftie-sermons: Fiftie godlie and learned sermons (1577, 1587): the older printing of the H. I. translation that the Parker Society Decades reprints
_excluded.bullinger-sacraments-1840: Sermons on the Sacraments (Cambridge, 1840): the sacrament sermons of the fifth Decade, already in the Parker Decades
_excluded.bullinger-matrimonye-other: the 1541, 1546 and 1548 printings of the Coverdale Matrimonye
_excluded.bullinger-cohabitacyon: PG 22151, the Cohabitacyon treatise: a joint Vermigli-Bullinger work, left pending on PR #14
_excluded.e-w-bullinger: E. W. Bullinger (1837-1913) is a different author, with his own shelf
